text: Over the 276 sessions to 05 Nov 26, the correlation between bitcoin's daily returns and the Nasdaq Composite's was 0.51 across the last 90 sessions, and 0.49 against the S&P 500. Against the Nasdaq over 252 sessions the beta is 1.08 with an R² of 0.23, so the index accounts for about 23% of the variance in bitcoin's daily returns. This is a description of the figures, not advice.
